sentences.text: Fixes don’t have to come from two bearings.
A bearing and a radar range on the same object make an excellent fix, because the two lines cross at right angles.
Radar ranges to two separate objects give two circles that cross.
A range line plus a bearing on another object works well.
An electronic fix from GPS is marked with a small triangle.
Whatever the method, cross-check every fix against another source, like the depth, before you trust it.
